hints.title: Grid Stepping Order
hints.text: Observe that moving strictly down or right forms an acyclic topological ordering.

hints.title: Blocked Cell Bypass
hints.text: Propagate paths only into cells that are neither blocked nor out of bounds.

hints.title: Cumulative Addition with Modulo
hints.text: Sum paths arriving from the top cell and left cell modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Iterative grid path counting with constant transitions per cell.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exhaustive branching over all right/down step sequences takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Maintains an M x N integer grid of path counts.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Apply 2D grid path formulation with correct base cases.
